children: January - June net income of Russia's largest oil producer by volumes, Rosneft

, declined by 18.4% from the year-earlier period, to 200 billion roubles ($2.32 billion) due to non-cash and one-off factors, including the rouble rate and assets impairment, the company said on Friday.

Rosneft also said its earnings before interest, taxes, depreciation and amortization increased in the fist half of the year by 23% to 1.296 trillion roubles, while revenue edged up 0.6% to 4.289 trillion roubles.
The company said it processed 35.5 million metric tons of crude oil in January - June, a decline from the same period last year. It did not provide the comparable data for refining throughput.
